Name: Kent Marriage Mod
Author: Ballshorse
Description:
[center][size=6][b][u]Kent Marriage Mod

[/u][/b][/size][size=4]This mod makes Kent into a fully fledged romanceable character adding:
[/size][/center][list]
[*]Ability to date / marry Kent
[*]Full pre-marriage dialogue
[*]Full post-marriage dialogue
[*]Multiple schedules depending on how many hearts you have with him including marriage schedules
[*]A full on story arc through nine heart events (2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 14)
[*]Some edited events and quests depending on heart levels
[*]Some edited dialogues for Sam, Vincent and Jodi
[*]Secret events
[*]A spouse portrait at the travelling merchant 
[*]Added animations for Kent
[/list]


This is my first ever mod to this scale so please be patient if there are bugs or errors if you download this! Please report them through the bugs section of the mod page and I can (hopefully!) fix it. It's also my first time doing any form of writing for a mod so I apologise if it's absolute DOOK. I would like to preface this my saying Kent is NOT my man, I just saw a gap in the market so I again apologise if I have done anyone's husband dirty. If you do have any suggestions or things you would edit, don't be afraid to tell me, just don't be mean about it : ) 

As well as bugs, please report any spelling/grammar mistakes to me in the posts section as I'm afraid I can barely write a thing that makes sense.



Before the more detailed descriptions, there are a few content warnings for this mod. I'd rather list things just in case as I don't want to make anyone uncomfortable if they didn't expect something that comes up:

[list]
[*]Mentions of war/imprisonment 
[*]PTSD
[*]Divorce
[/list]


[size=4]How to trigger events:

[/size][list]
[*]Vanilla events (meeting, Jodi fish casserole and three heart event are the same conditions)
[*]Two heart:  Two hearts with Kent, Saloon between 16:00 and 18:00
[*]Four heart:  Four hearts with Kent, Saloon between 19:00 and 22:00
[*]Six heart: Six hearts with Kent, Pelican Town between 09;00 and 16:00 (After seeing this event, Kent's schedule will permanently change) 
[*]Eight Hearts: Eight hearts with Kent,  weather is rainy,  beach between 22:00 and 02:00
[*]Ten hearts: Ten hearts with Kent, has received the invitation in the mail, Bus stop between 20:00 and 21:00
[*]Eleven hearts:  Eleven hearts with Kent, have second house upgrade, should happen when you wake up (farmhouse between 06:00 and 06:10)
[*]Twelve hearts: Twelve hearts with Kent, weather is sunny, season is summer, has entered the walnut room at least once (I am so sorry, there is a lore reason for this), Beach between 10:00 and 17:00
[*]Fourteen hearts part one:  Fourteen hearts with Kent, not winter,  have second house upgrade, should happen as soon as you wake up (farmhouse between 06:00 and 06:10)
[*]Fourteen heart event part two:  Seen part one,  Bus stop between 10:00 and 11:00
[*]*SPECIAL EVENT*:  Dating both Sam and Kent with both at ten hearts, at Sam's house anytime. Different events if you are carrying a rabbit's foot or not.
[/list][size=5]
[/size]I have tried to write this so Kent and Jodi splitting up is as amicable as possible as it's a small town and would end in a disaster. they remain good friends after the divorce. Also Kent will not want to have children so if that's something you really want to do, post it in the asks and I'll tell you how to over-ride it in your save.[size=5]
[/size]


[size=4]Compatibility:

[/size]
This mod should be compatible with most mods,. Mods that will NOT be compatible are ones that change Kent's sprites and portraits such as seasonal cute characters (you can still have it on for others, just not Kent) and ones that change the Saloon map. Unfortunately, this includes SDV expanded. The only mods I wouldn't be certain on is mods that change Kent's dialogue or schedules and small compatibility issues with ones that change Sam's dialogue and schedule.


To work this mod will need:

[list]
[*]Content patcher
[*]SMAPI
[*]spacecore
[*]Recommended: ﻿Custom spouse pet names and stardrop dialogue by KaliRivera  (this will let you chose the nicknames Kent calls you in marriage dialogue)
[*]Recommended: Hugs and kisses continued by JoWX (For kissing before marriage (Kents kiss frame is 28 and facing right: false))
[/list]

[/size]If you want to edit this mod in any way,  including translations, please ask permission first as if anyone does want to do translations, I would like to keep on top of what's being made. I will most of the time be happy for it, : )

Feel free to use any of the code (not content) in your mods! You don't need permission for this! Also if you're not too sure how something works, I'm happy to try and explain it.

If you want to make any edits at all to just your personal save, that's totally fine, just please don't release anything publicly without checking it by me first.

Do not upload this to any other website. If this mod is listed anywhere but here, please report it as I only upload to Nexusmods.
